task: Generate an architectural research report for a native Rust omnichannel chat system.
solution: Audited the Chatwoot repository to understand its data models and real-time webhook architecture. Created a detailed Mermaid architecture and output the findings into `.agent-task/report/task_output.md` following the required YAML structure.
learnings: When writing Playwright tests or instructions for implementers, ensure you explicitly forbid mocking internal network requests or database behavior to adhere to the strict testing mandates. Always verify the `issue_description` covers all requested fields such as 'Estimated Scope'.
